A FEW STRAIGHT ANSWERS

Before you ask.

Can I buy these T-shirts?

No. KOVA is a fictional portfolio brand. The prices, fits and product images are concepts.

Will I get an email after signing up?

No. The form only demonstrates validation and a success state. No email is stored or sent.

What gets measured here?

A small event log is saved in this browser for demonstration. It records event names, selected product concepts and allowlisted campaign tags, not email addresses. Nothing is sent to an analytics provider.

Where can I see the marketing work?

Open the campaign case study for the research, creatives, ad copy, emails, calendar and measurement plan.
